data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (World Bank, then Wikipedia, then a mail draft with subject "<Country> macro snapshot", then Discard) and the data fields are right, but it leaves out the GDP growth scroll step and the exact body template, and it lists the recipient as an email parameter when the true workflow derives it from {client}@example.com, so an automation would need guesswork.
